item.name: Wooden Bucket
item.notes: Starter bucket equipped at the beginning of every run.
item.cardSummary: The free starter bucket with no passive bonus. Use it until you unlock a shop, wheel, or badge upgrade in the lobby.

item.name: Plastic Bucket
item.notes: Cheapest paid shop upgrade at the lobby Buckets station.
item.cardSummary: A 200 Gem shop bucket that fills slightly faster. A common first purchase when you leave the starter tool behind.

item.name: Metal Bucket
item.cardSummary: A 500 Gem shop bucket with +2 capacity. Fewer trips to the drain once you can afford the upgrade.

item.name: Magnet Bucket
item.effect: Automatically collects Token earnings and grants +5% Token earnings.
item.cardSummary: A 1,200 Gem shop bucket that auto-collects Tokens and adds a small Token earnings bonus.

item.name: Golden Bucket
item.effect: +15% Token earnings. Pours can yield Diamonds.
item.notes: Highest Gem-shop cost among standard lobby buckets.
item.cardSummary: A 2,000 Gem Legendary shop bucket with +15% Token earnings and a chance for Diamonds when you pour.

item.name: Toilet Bucket
item.effect: +3 bucket capacity. 10% chance to auto-flush and cash out when full.
item.notes: Unlocked from the lobby Bucket Wheel, not the Gem shop.
item.cardSummary: A Rare wheel bucket with +3 capacity and a 10% chance to auto-cash out when full.

item.name: Toxic Bucket
item.effect: +20% Token earnings. 10% chance to instantly cash out when full.
item.notes: Wheel reward. Guides report roughly a 1% spin drop, and spins may require Robux packs.
item.cardSummary: A Legendary wheel bucket with a large Token earnings bonus and a 10% chance to cash out instantly when full.

item.name: Ancient Bucket
item.effect: +10% Token earnings. Digs up higher-tier gems.
item.notes: Claim in the lobby after 10 badges and joining the IWTM10GTMPLS Roblox group.
item.cardSummary: A free Legendary unlock after 10 badges and joining the creator group. Adds Token earnings and better gem digs.

item.name: Shark Bucket
item.notes: Listed as a Mythic Robux bucket that is not currently obtainable.
item.cardSummary: A Mythic Robux bucket that can scoop triple water on a 15% chance, but it is currently unobtainable.

item.name: Dragon Bucket
item.effect: +20% Token earnings. 15% chance to double a payout.
item.notes: Limited Robux purchase. Exact Robux price differs across guides, so it is not listed here.
item.cardSummary: A limited Mythic Robux bucket with +20% Token earnings and a 15% chance to double payouts.
